message.content: In the group discussion on 20260629_18:30, ChaeSong-hwa expresses interest in adding upbeat songs to the playlist, suggesting "Uptown Funk" and "Happy." These upbeat tracks were proposed as a way to bring more energy to their sessions. However, Chae also mentions bringing in several classics for the band to try, which indicates that he prefers to focus on established and well-loved songs rather than solely recommending new, upbeat tracks.
